sound.hint: Open your mouth wide, pull lips back, and make a short front vowel.

grammar.title: Expressing complex emotions: I am grateful for... / She feels hopeful.
grammar.ex1: I am very grateful for your help. = Estoy muy agradecido/a por tu ayuda.

phrase.es: Estoy verdaderamente agradecido/a por todo lo que haces.

translate: Estoy muy agradecido por tu ayuda.
I am very grateful for your help.
Él se siente energético esta mañana.
practice.write: Write 3 things you are grateful for today.

sound.hint: Place your top teeth lightly on your lower lip and vibrate your vocal cords.
sound.line1: view · valuable · visit   →   top teeth touch lower lip, voiced air
sound.line2: /f/   few · fine · fan   →   same mouth position, unvoiced blowing air

grammar.title: Sharing perspectives: From my perspective, ... / In my view, ...
grammar.ex1: In my view, this course is very valuable. = En mi opinión, este curso es muy valioso.
grammar.ex2: I consider this decision very important. = Considero que esta decisión es muy importante.

phrase.en: From my perspective, hard work always pays off.
phrase.es: Desde mi perspectiva, el trabajo duro siempre da frutos.

speak: Give your opinion using 'In my view...' out loud.
Say out loud: 'I consider this lesson very valuable.'
Express your viewpoint: 'From my perspective, this is the best way.'

In my view, this course is very valuable.
Considero que esta decisión es importante.
I consider this decision very important.
practice.write: Write 2 sentences expressing your perspective on learning English in the US.

sound.hint: Press the back of your tongue against the soft palate and release a voiced burst.
sound.line1: exact · agreement · good   →   voiced sound from back of throat
sound.line2: /k/   exact · correct · key   →   unvoiced sound from back of throat

grammar.title: Stating agreement clearly: We are in agreement. / That is exactly right!
grammar.ex1: That is exactly what I was thinking! = ¡Eso es exactamente lo que estaba pensando!
grammar.ex2: We reached a good agreement today. = Llegamos a un buen acuerdo hoy.

phrase.en: That is exactly right, I completely agree with you.
phrase.es: Eso es exactamente correcto, estoy completamente de acuerdo contigo.

speak: Practice agreeing strongly: 'That is exactly right!'
Say out loud: 'We are in full agreement on this topic.'
Politely correct someone: 'That statement is incorrect.'
translate: Eso es exactamente lo que estaba pensando.
That is exactly what I was thinking!
Llegamos a un buen acuerdo hoy.
We reached a good agreement today.
practice.write: Write 2 sentences agreeing and disagreeing politely with an opinion.

sound.hint: Place the tip of your tongue against the ridge behind your upper teeth and release air.
sound.line1: clarify · louder · spell   →   tongue tip on ridge behind front teeth

grammar.title: Asking for clarification: Could you clarify...? / Please speak louder / slower.

grammar.ex2: Please speak a little louder. = Por favor hable un poco más alto.

phrase.en: Could you please rephrase that sentence?
phrase.es: ¿Podría por favor reformular esa oración?

speak: Practice asking someone to speak louder in English.
Say out loud: 'Could you clarify what you mean?'
Ask someone to spell their name: 'Could you spell your name, please?'
translate: Could you clarify that point, please?
Por favor hable un poco más alto.
practice.write: Write 3 sentences asking for clarification during a conversation.

sound.hint: Start with an open ah sound and glide up into oo as your lips round.

grammar.title: Giving sincere compliments: That is a wonderful... / You are very talented!
